display.purpose: Hero h1 only — the single largest type; the accented name is the one ember word.

stat.purpose: Big Syne numbers on the drenched ember stats panel in the Projects bento.

title.purpose: Section headings, project titles, role titles, contact heading — always Syne.

body.purpose: Bio and prose. Satoshi, loaded from the Fontshare CDN in index.html (split strategy: Syne and IBM Plex Sans Thai load via @import in global.css). Cap measure 65-75ch.

body-th.purpose: Thai prose; IBM Plex Sans Thai, swapped under [data-lang="th"].

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows, row labels, nav links, card tags. Four words or fewer.

shadows.name: floating-card
shadows.purpose: Compact project cards that read as lifted tiles.

motion.name: theme-fade
motion.value: background-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease
motion.purpose: Global crossfade applied to all elements for theme (dark/light) switching.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section scroll-reveal: translateY(24px) + fade, triggered by IntersectionObserver at 0.1 threshold. NEEDS a reduced-motion fallback.

narrative.overview: A single warm light in a dark, careful room. The interface is built on a near-black warm brown (#131110) and lit by exactly one color: a burnt-orange ember (#d4651a). Everything else is structure — hairline rules, restrained type, generous air. The mood is a workshop after hours: someone who takes pride in the joinery, working by lamplight, in no hurry to shout about it. The system is token-driven and flat: surfaces sit on 0.5px borders rather than heavy shadows, depth comes from tonal layering, and every section is separated by a single hairline rule. It rejects the generic template portfolio, the corporate SaaS landing page, and over-designed gimmickry.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black canvas lit by one ember-orange accent; no second hue competes.
Hairline (0.5px) borders and section rules as the primary structural device.
Flat by default; soft ambient shadow only on truly floating surfaces.
Syne (display) paired with a humanist body sans; weight and size carry hierarchy.
Dual-theme (warm-dark default, warm-light) and dual-language (EN/TH), both first-class.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent color exists. #d4651a is the only saturated hue anywhere, used on roughly <=10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black, No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: The canvas is #131110, never #000. Text is #f0e8e0, never #fff. Warmth lives in the neutrals.

rules.name: The Syne-for-Structure Rule
rules.body: Headings, titles, the wordmark, and stat numbers are Syne; anything read in sentences is the body sans. The two never trade jobs.

rules.name: The Short-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + letter-spacing is reserved for labels of four words or fewer. Body copy is never all-caps or tracked out.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 0.5px borders and section rules. Reach for a hairline before a shadow; shadows are earned only by floating elements.

dos: Do keep #d4651a as the only accent — one ember, <=10% of any screen.
Do build structure with 0.5px hairline borders and section rules before reaching for a shadow.
Do use Syne for every structural/heading element and the body sans for every readable sentence.
Do keep the canvas warm near-black (#131110) and text warm bone (#f0e8e0) — never #000, never #fff.
Do set EN and TH as equals: correct lang/[data-lang] semantics, comfortable Thai line-height, IBM Plex Sans Thai swap.
Do slot new layered UI into the z-index ladder (10 / 50 / 100 / 101), never arbitrary 999s.
Do keep the full-bleed 5vw gutter and the mobile-first 375 -> 768 -> 1280 breakpoints.
donts: Don't build a generic template portfolio: no identical card grid, no skill progress bars, no hero-plus-three-cards scaffold.
Don't drift toward a corporate SaaS landing page: no big gradient hero, no feature-metric template, no enterprise blue.
Don't over-design: no pile of competing animations or decorative effects that distract from the work.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient, or gradient text.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe; structure is full hairline borders or nothing.
Don't gate content visibility purely on a JS-added class; content must stay readable if the reveal never fires.
Don't ship animations without a prefers-reduced-motion fallback (not yet implemented for reveals, typing, icon swap).
Don't assume the fonts load from one place: Satoshi loads from the Fontshare CDN (index.html), Syne/IBM Plex Sans Thai via @import in global.css; keep both wired and keep the sans-serif fallback.
Don't drop sustained text onto the faintest neutrals (#5a5248, #6a6058); verify >=4.5:1 in both themes.
